_about: v2.4 plan 08 T18 per-role calibration, authoring role (runAuthoringStage: the wizard's real stage prompt, parser, validator and its one repair pass). Labels frozen 2026-09-25 BEFORE any model answer was read. validity = the product's own verdict is 'ok' or 'questions'. opShape = status 'ok', every op is a kind the stage prompt allows ('Only emit ... ops', read from the rendered prompt), and at least `require.min` ops of `require.kind` whose `require.match` fields hold; a 'questions' answer passes opShape only when `ask` is 'allowed' (a premise too thin to proceed on). Floors are in 08-author-observability.md section 'Per-role calibration floors' and in `floors` below; they are never retuned. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case instead.
